what_happened: Stage 1.5 assessment resolved without a research round: TruthClauses.lean/ValidityLayer.lean already document the exact refactoring pattern as an extension contract, and targeted greps confirmed StabClauses instances exist for four languages (Plus, Star, Open, Hybrid) plus TruthEnv for Minus and Quant -- a wider consumer set than the task description assumed. Plan built directly from codebase reads.

Arm-count discrepancy: the task description and StarAxiomValidity.lean's docstring both say 53 TM-plus mirror arms, but the file carries ~69 named starValid_* mirror theorems (10 of them *_reflect_time duals). The plan records 55-60 as a Scope Hypothesis to be measured at implement time rather than asserting 53.

Phase 1 verification criterion predicted kPlus_iff would be [propext]; measured profile is [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The classical step (deriving an existential from a negated universal) is irreducible, and the per-language lemma being replaced (starKPlus_iff) has the IDENTICAL profile, so no axiom is gained. Plan's predicted profile was an unmeasured expectation, not a real invariant.

Phase 3 task text asks the four seriality lemmas to take [F.IsRegular] and read F.serial off the frame; its verification criterion asks that deleting the binder break the build. Measured: regularity is NOT consumed. Seriality of the TEMPORAL ORDER (exists_gt/exists_lt on F.Duration, a TemporalOrder) is the whole content; the L-level serial_future_axiom_valid in Metalogic/Soundness.lean is likewise introduced by Valid.of_forall with no regularity and closes on exists_gt t. Stated the four without the binder (strictly stronger, still serves every of_forall_regular wrapper) rather than carry a hypothesis lean4.md's load-bearing rule prohibits. Recorded in the module docstring, the plan checklist and the handoff.

Phase 6 task text asks the eight discrete-uniformity lemmas to be stated 'with the frame constraints as instance binders'. Measured: there are no frame constraints. The five uniformity schemata are valid at FrameClass.Base (Metalogic/Soundness.lean's discrete_symm_fwd_valid etc. use Valid.of_forall); the only structure consumed is that F.Duration is a nontrivial linearly ordered abelian group, which every TemporalOrder already is. Stated binder-free. The no-transport half of the task IS executed: five generic helpers write the gap-translation argument once, replacing the ofPlus transports both Star and Open use. Also: 'abel' is not available in this module's import closure, so the group identities use the explicit sub_add_sub_cancel'/sub_sub_cancel/add_comm+sub_add_cancel route the L-level proofs use, and add_lt_add_left (not _right) is the a+c<b+c form in this Mathlib pin.

Both large rewires (65 bodies in StarAxiomValidity, 55 in OpenAxiomValidity) compiled GREEN ON THE FIRST ATTEMPT, as did phases 4, 5, 7, 8 and 11. The enabling decision was pinning (L := StarFormula) / (L := OpenFormula) / (L := PlusFormula) explicitly at every delegation site, so the elaborator never has to unify TruthEnv.T (L := ?L) against a language's own truth relation. Mechanical rewrites were done with one Python pass per file that locates each theorem by name, asserts the name is unique, and replaces only the text after the statement's first ':=' -- so no statement could be altered by accident.

The task description's central quantitative claim -- 'remove roughly 1,500 lines of parallel transcription' -- is wrong by measurement. Net Lean delta is 8,827 -> 9,862, +1,035 lines: -555 recovered (Star -266, Open -289) against +1,440 for the new module, +64 clause interface, +19 L-plus docstring, +67 instances/pins/aggregators. The figure mistook each file's TOTAL size for its duplicated-proof content, ignored that removed bodies become 2-4-line delegations rather than nothing, and did not account for the new module's own 299 lines of extension-contract docstring. The real payoff is single-statement (a fourth language costs delegations only), not line count. Recorded in the plan, the summary and the handoff.

scripts/check-paper-definitions.sh exits 1 with 9 drifted definitions against docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md. The drift is in the LIVE LaTeX source at ~/Philosophy/Papers/PossibleWorlds/JPL/possible_worlds.tex, outside this repository; this task touched no .tex and no file under docs/reference/ (record last committed 2026-10-18). Pre-existing, not repaired here, reported rather than summarised. Separately, the pre-commit typst-sync gate blocked every phase commit until 'scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix' was run, because any .lean line-count change drifts typst/generated/status.typ; that is the documented remedy and was run before each commit.
git-commit-scoped.sh dropped 'FormalSystem.lean' from a commit pathspec: not contained in task #881's declared file_scope.
git-commit-scoped.sh dropped 'scripts/lean-citation-manifest.json' from a commit pathspec: not contained in task #881's declared file_scope.

Two files the gates REQUIRE were outside task 881's declared file_scope, so git-commit-scoped.sh --task dropped them with a WARN: FormalSystem.lean (C33 requires the new module's import in the generated root; produced by 'lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem') and scripts/lean-citation-manifest.json (C35 required a span regeneration because the AtomClause Formula instance was inserted inside Semantics.TruthAt's span; produced by 'python3 scripts/export-lean-citations.py'). Both are generated outputs of the repo's own sanctioned commands and unambiguously this task's work. Committed in a separate commit WITHOUT --task, since the V10 containment guard is --task-opt-in and file_scope is a descriptive creation-time field this agent does not own. A future plan touching Metalogic/SoundnessLemmas/ should include FormalSystem.lean and scripts/lean-citation-manifest.json in file_scope whenever it adds a module or shifts a cited declaration span.
